issues.description: Element: StockIngredient.price field, its constructor parameter type, and getPrice() return type. The template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) declares price as double (constructor parameter double, private final double price, and public double getPrice()), whereas the problem statement's UML and method signatures (acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int)) and the reference solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) use int for price. This mismatch forces students to reconcile inconsistent types (int vs double) when calling new StockIngredient(name, price, quantity) or when summing prices in calculateTotalPrice, leading to confusion and possible unnecessary casts or subtle bugs.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template StockIngredient to use int for price consistently: update the field to 'private final int price;', the constructor parameter to take an int price, and the getPrice() method to return int. This aligns the template with the UML in the problem statement and the reference solution, and avoids type confusion when implementing acceptSupplyDelivery and calculateTotalPrice.
